verdict.rationale: Caveman documents its own automations that run on a GitHub event, alongside manual and scheduled runs. It also has rules that mask or block content and cap crossings that automatically raise Inbox items and emails, so event-driven triggering is a first-party capability. The evidence is a single marketing line per feature, and the only user-definable event source shown is GitHub. Missing for 10: documentation of how trigger rules and conditions are defined, event sources beyond GitHub, configurable actions per event, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
